translations.reason: Requires epistemic operator 'knows that' which is not available in classical propositional/first-order logic
While propositionally expressible, its relationship to premise requires epistemic logic for proper formalization

interpretation_notes: The entire argument cannot be formalized in classical logic due to epistemic modality in premise
The implicit inference from knowledge to truth (Kp → p) requires epistemic logic axioms not available here
Both claims retain propositional symbols but lack formalizable connection in classical logic
